staticText: IELTS score worksheet for four whole- or half-band section scores, official overall rounding, and comparison with a user-entered overall target. Listening raw-mark practice estimates are shared; Academic and General Training Reading estimates are separate and may vary slightly by test version. Raw estimates only prefill section bands and never create an eligibility result. The tool does not infer component minimums, admissions, visa eligibility, professional registration or equivalence to TOEFL, PTE or Duolingo.
